request.query: A finitely supported natural function on Option is the sum of the lifted restriction and its value at none

items.name: Finsupp.sum_option_index
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} [inst : AddZeroClass M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] (f : Option α →₀ M)
  (b : Option α → M → N),
  (∀ (o : Option α), b o 0 = 0) →
    (∀ (o : Option α) (m₁ m₂ : M), b o (m₁ + m₂) = b o m₁ + b o m₂) →
      f.sum b = b none (f none) + f.some.sum fun a => b (some a)

items.name: Finsupp.optionElim
items.type: {α : Type u_1} → {M : Type u_2} → [inst : Zero M] → M → (α →₀ M) → Option α →₀ M

items.name: Fintype.sum_option
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] (f : Option α → M),
  ∑ i, f i = f none + ∑ i, f (some i)

items.name: finsum_option
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : Option α → M},
  (Function.support (f ∘ some)).Finite → ∑ᶠ (o : Option α), f o = f none + ∑ᶠ (a : α), f (some a)

items.name: Finset.sum_insertNone
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : Option α → M) (s : Finset α),
  ∑ x ∈ Finset.insertNone s, f x = f none + ∑ x ∈ s, f (some x)
